Name: A Moss Food Pack
Author: Luwenl
Description:
[b]Moss Cooking[/b] introduces
 six unique cooking recipes inspired by the moss found throughout Stardew Valley.
This mod was created with a playful idea in mind — foods so unusual that players might first think, [i]“Wait… what is this?”[/i]
